body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Motorola announced the launch of its new ''MOTORIZR Z6'' during CES 2007.

The most noticeable feature of the MOTORIZR is that it supports Linux OS incorporating kJava. It has Windows Media Player 11 and Integrated music player that supports multiple audio files including Windows WMAv10 plus Janus DRM, MP3, AAC, AAC+, AAC+ enhanced, AMR NB, WAV, and XMF. It also offers USB 2.0 for high speed transfers and data access.
It is expected to be available in Q1 2007.
